verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad public API surface covering catalog, inventory, locations, orders, disputes, payouts and Terminal, plus webhooks and a sandbox. Official SDKs on GitHub show programmatic calls such as `client.payments.create`, and an llms.txt index and a published API specification repo add agent-friendly entry points. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of driving the API, and an OpenAPI spec at standard discoverable paths (the probes returned 404).
